relation_override.rationale: Author decision: the clock dependence in CL and GT is an explicit contrast of operations, as recorded in X::0003. CL's pair-event epoch hides triad events (a time change plus a projection); GT's continuous and jump clocks share one event sequence and differ only in holding-time weighting. The seed's compatibility reading survives as theme membership (C::clock-readout-dependence), not as the relation type.
